title: Validate layout before staged construction
applies_when: New enclosed space or base expansion is needed.
approach: Inspect explored terrain, existing structures and mountains near the intended colony site. Consider reuse before new construction.
Design the whole usable space, including entrances and interior circulation, before staging its pieces.
Choose materials from native availability and allowed materials. Stage useful portions around labor and supply rather than scattering unrelated pieces.
verify: Footprints, obstructions, enclosure, roof support/coverage and reachable entrances.
Furniture access and conflicts with existing or pending placements. A valid placement is not proof of a completed room.
reconsider: Geometry is incomplete or uncertain: request more observation rather than guessing.
Player changes the layout or materials become unavailable.
